title: Named Conversion Gate Calendar
record_scope: Eight next-evidence gates, one for each Phase 61 named file, joined to the latest Phase 62 event and any same-entity Phase 60 cycle binding.
interpretation_boundary: Schedule bands organize editorial work. They are not readiness, probability, risk, value, performance, or urgency scores, and a dated check is not evidence that its target artifact will exist.

calendar_contract.date_rule: A dated file preserves the exact Phase 61 next-check date. A trigger-based file preserves the source-explicit reopening trigger and does not receive an invented calendar date.
calendar_contract.receipt_rule: No gate advances from scheduled or trigger-based state without an actual source check, one allowed receipt type, a decision date, and complete propagation.
calendar_contract.overdue_rule: After a dated gate passes, the release assertion must find a receipt or fail; silence cannot become an implicit no-change decision.
calendar_contract.no_transfer_rule: Only Phase 60 items explicitly bound by Phase 62 may append to a named file, and a conditional binding must still change the same named receiving-system stage.

gate_records.current_stage: Facility build and bounded production claim
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A facility-specific accepted utility, inspection, occupancy, qualification, customer-acceptance, or compatible recurring production record.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not infer accepted service or campus-wide output from utility territory, an agreement, construction status, or one facility claim.

gate_records.named_entity: Victoria Park Avenue and Thora Avenue application 24 254930
gate_records.current_stage: City Council adoption with amendment bills withheld
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: Introduced or enacted amendment numbers, accepted condition-compliance records, or the first confirmed permit, start, completion, or occupancy record for the application.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not treat Council adoption as enactment or use aggregate Toronto and CMHC stages as this project's delivery outcome.

gate_records.named_entity: Golden-Mars transmission project and Dominion GS-5 service class
gate_records.current_stage: Conditional transmission authority and approved future rate class
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A final route or land decision followed by construction, inspection, energization, or a named GS-5 customer service record.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not convert a forecast, rate class, application, or conditional approval into available capacity or accepted customer service.

gate_records.named_entity: Shuttle Landing Facility, LC-39A, and SLC-40
gate_records.current_stage: Mixed site and environmental authority with one unresolved licence rail
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: The FAA's formal Shuttle Landing Facility licence disposition or a named operator authorization, accepted capital asset, mission, or repeated service record.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not treat environmental review, a site licence, or an infrastructure milestone as operator approval, mission completion, or corridor reliability.
gate_records.receipt_state: Recheck Scheduled After Bounded No Material Change

gate_records.current_stage: Authorized and financed project rails before qualified material
gate_records.reopening_trigger: An official project, regulator, lender, or customer record reaches construction acceptance, commissioning, compliance, qualification, shipment, or recurring output.
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A named inspection, construction completion, commissioning test, compliant operating measurement, qualified lot, customer receipt, or recurring output series.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not convert authorization, a permit, financial close, projected capacity, or reserve context into qualified domestic supply.

gate_records.current_stage: Named federal procurement mechanism before an agency migration
gate_records.reopening_trigger: An official agency or GSA record identifies a named PQC procurement or system migration milestone.
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A named agency inventory, solicitation, award, interoperability test, cutover, acceptance, or legacy-retirement record.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not treat a buyer's guide, standard, draft credential specification, or deadline as an order or completed migration.

gate_records.current_stage: Multi-level evaluation pilot before continuous system assurance
gate_records.reopening_trigger: NIST or a participating institution publishes a named system-level assurance, deployment, or outcome artifact.
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A named system evaluation and authorization record linked to deployment monitoring, incident handling, corrective action, or a stable mission-outcome measure.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not treat an evaluation pilot, framework, inventory, or purchasing channel as assured operation or measured benefit.

gate_records.named_entity: Waymo fared driverless passenger service in California
gate_records.current_stage: Expanded service authority before a comparable persistent-outcome series
gate_records.reopening_trigger: CPUC or another official California authority publishes a current operator-level passenger-service and outcome rollup.
gate_records.exact_next_artifact: A stable Waymo operating series with geography, period, service exposure, rides, interventions, safety events, accessibility, complaints, and comparable definitions.
gate_records.stop_rule: Do not convert legal authority, testing miles, or a reporting requirement into persistent service quality, safety, accessibility, or adoption.
